competitiveTarget: Beat generic 'list with us' pages: the ask (address-capture form) in the hero, proof directly after it (live MLS track record, real sold homes, verbatim Google reviews), honest value props, and every valuation CTA anchored to the on-page form, with zero invented results or 'verifiable results' claims (D99).
note: Conversion-first rework 2026-07-11 on the KB (kinetic-brutalist) base. The proven /lp/seller-home-value two-step form (SellerLPForm: Places autocomplete, partial-lead capture, FUB workflow + broker assignment + CMA queue) now renders INSIDE KbHero via formSlot with pagePath='/sell' attribution — the page is no longer form-less. The page leads with the SERVICE story (Matt 2026-07-11: selling a home is not just the home's value): value props, process, marketing plan, and fee come first; SellProof (live getBrokerageTrackRecord ledger + Sold Stories cards with verbatim paired reviews) and KbTestimonials (seller-side verified Google reviews) follow as supporting proof. All internal valuation CTAs (SellValuationCTA, CTABar, sticky mobile bar) anchor to #get-value instead of navigating to the LP. Prior history: KB conversion 2026-06-18 (Phase 9); 'How it works' ContentSection removed 2026-07 (duplicate of SellProcess); early-CTA strip removed 2026-07-11 (superseded by the hero form). Current-market line is live getMarketPulse(Bend) at an 8s ISR-revalidation timeout (the prior 3.5s budget silently blanked the live numbers), classified by canonical MoS thresholds. HideChrome remains deferred to the orchestrator.
